app_fee.value: Central research guidance outlines tuition fees and postgraduate funding without stating a general application fee for research degree programmes.

fee_waiver.value: Central guidance does not publish fee waiver procedures as no general PGR application fee is stated.

gre_general.value: GRE General test is not required or requested centrally for postgraduate research admission at Nottingham.

toefl_min.value: Nottingham accepts TOEFL iBT as an alternative qualification alongside course-specific IELTS requirements.
toefl_min.quote: This includes TOEFL iBT, Pearson PTE, GCSE, IB and O level English.

ielts_min.value: Standard minimum English requirement for research programmes is IELTS 6.5 with at least 6.0 in each element.

english_waiver.value: Exemption applies only to native English speakers or applicants who studied in approved English-speaking countries on the UK government list; degrees from India do not qualify.
english_waiver.quote: If you're a native English speaker, or you have studied in an English-speaking country or institution, we may be able to accept your academic qualifications as evidence of your English language ability. Check the list of approved countries on the UK government website.

notes: Postgraduate research degrees at the University of Nottingham include PhD and MRes programmes across faculties.
